verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וָשֵׁשׁ֙ לְמַלְכ֣וּת אָסָ֔א עָלָ֞ה בַּעְשָׁ֤א מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עַל־ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּ֖בֶן אֶת־ הָרָמָ֑ה לְבִלְתִּ֗י תֵּ֚ת יוֹצֵ֣א וָבָ֔א לְאָסָ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ šə·lō·šîm wā·šêš lə·mal·ḵūṯ ’ā·sā ‘ā·lāh ba‘·šā me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh way·yi·ḇen ’eṯ- hā·rā·māh lə·ḇil·tî têṯ yō·w·ṣê wā·ḇā lə·’ā·sā me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: In the thirty-sixth . . . . . . year of Asa’s reign Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah
verses.literalPt: NO trigésimo sexto ano do reinado de Asa, Baasa, rei de Israel, subiu contra Judá e edificou a Ramá, para não deixar ninguém sair, nem chegar a Asa, rei de Judá.

verses.original: וַיֹּצֵ֨א אָסָ֜א כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֗ב מֵאֹֽצְר֛וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וּבֵ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֶל־ בֶּן־ הֲדַד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם הַיּוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּדַרְמֶ֖שֶׂק לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·ṣê ’ā·sā ke·sep̄ wə·zā·hāḇ mê·’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ bêṯ Yah·weh ū·ḇêṯ ham·me·leḵ way·yiš·laḥ ’el- ben- hă·ḏaḏ me·leḵ ’ă·rām hay·yō·wō·šêḇ bə·ḏar·me·śeq lê·mōr
verses.literal: So Asa withdrew the silver and gold from the treasuries of the house of the LORD and the royal palace and he sent it with this message to Ben-hadad king of Aram who was ruling in Damascus
verses.literalPt: Então Asa tirou a prata e o ouro dos tesouros da casa do SENHOR, e da casa do rei; e enviou servos a Ben-Hadade, rei da Síria, que habitava em Damasco, dizendo:

verses.original: בְּרִית֙ בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֔ךָ וּבֵ֥ין אָבִ֖י וּבֵ֣ין אָבִ֑יךָ הִנֵּ֨ה שָׁלַ֤חְתִּֽי לְךָ֙ כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֔ב לֵ֞ךְ הָפֵ֣ר בְּרִֽיתְךָ֗ אֶת־ בַּעְשָׁא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְיַעֲלֶ֖ה מֵעָלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rîṯ bê·nî ū·ḇê·ne·ḵā ū·ḇên ’ā·ḇî ū·ḇên ’ā·ḇî·ḵā hin·nêh šā·laḥ·tî lə·ḵā ke·sep̄ wə·zā·hāḇ lêḵ hā·p̄êr bə·rî·ṯə·ḵā ’eṯ- ba‘·šā me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl wə·ya·‘ă·leh mê·‘ā·lāy
verses.literal: Let there be a treaty between me and you as there was between . . . my father . . . and your father See I have sent you silver and gold Now go and break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel so that he will withdraw from me
verses.literalPt: Acordo há entre mim e ti, como houve entre meu pai e o teu; eis que te envio prata e ouro; vai, pois, e anula o teu acordo com Baasa, rei de Israel, para que se retire de sobre mim.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע בֶּן הֲדַ֜ד אֶל־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָסָ֗א וַ֠יִּשְׁלַח אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֨י הַחֲיָלִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר־ לוֹ֙ אֶל־ עָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּכּוּ֙ אֶת־ עִיּ֣וֹן וְאֶת־ דָּ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת אָבֵ֣ל מָ֑יִם וְאֵ֥ת כָּֽל־ מִסְכְּנ֖וֹת עָרֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ bɛn hă·ḏaḏ ’el- ham·me·leḵ ’ā·sā way·yiš·laḥ ’eṯ- śā·rê ha·ḥă·yā·lîm ’ă·šer- lōw ’el- ‘ā·rê yiś·rā·’êl way·yak·kū ’eṯ- ‘î·yō·wn wə·’eṯ- dān wə·’êṯ ’ā·ḇêl mā·yim wə·’êṯ kāl- mis·kə·nō·wṯ ‘ā·rê nap̄·tā·lî
verses.literal: And Ben-hadad listened to King Asa and sent the commanders of his armies against the cities of Israel conquering Ijon Dan Abel-maim and all the store cities of Naphtali
verses.literalPt: E Ben-Hadade deu ouvidos ao rei Asa, e enviou os capitães dos seus exércitos, contra as cidades de Israel, e eles feriram a Ijom, a Dã, a Abel-Maim, e a todas as cidades-armazéns de Naftali.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ בַּעְשָׁ֔א וַיֶּחְדַּ֕ל מִבְּנ֖וֹת אֶת־ הָרָמָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁבֵּ֖ת אֶת־ מְלַאכְתּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî kiš·mō·a‘ ba‘·šā way·yeḥ·dal mib·bə·nō·wṯ ’eṯ- hā·rā·māh way·yaš·bêṯ ’eṯ- mə·laḵ·tōw
verses.literal: When Baasha learned of this he stopped fortifying Ramah and abandoned his work
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo-o Baasa, deixou de edificar a Ramá, e não continuou a sua obra.

verses.original: וְאָסָ֣א הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ לָקַח֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּשְׂא֞וּ אֶת־ אַבְנֵ֤י הָֽרָמָה֙ וְאֶת־ עֵצֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה בַּעְשָׁ֑א וַיִּ֣בֶן בָּהֶ֔ם אֶת־ גֶּ֖בַע וְאֶת־ הַמִּצְפָּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·sā ham·me·leḵ lā·qaḥ ’eṯ- kāl- yə·hū·ḏāh way·yiś·’ū ’eṯ- ’aḇ·nê hā·rā·māh wə·’eṯ- ‘ê·ṣe·hā ’ă·šer bā·nāh ba‘·šā way·yi·ḇen bā·hem ’eṯ- ge·ḇa‘ wə·’eṯ- ham·miṣ·pāh
verses.literal: Then King Asa brought all the men of Judah and they carried away the stones of Ramah and the timbers Baasha had used for building And with these materials he built up Geba and Mizpah
verses.literalPt: Então o rei Asa tomou a todo o Judá, e levaram as pedras de Ramá, e a sua madeira, com que Baasa edificara; e com elas edificou a Geba e a Mizpá.

verses.original: וּבָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא בָּ֚א חֲנָ֣נִי הָרֹאֶ֔ה אֶל־ אָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו בְּהִשָּׁ֨עֶנְךָ֜ עַל־ מֶ֤לֶךְ אֲרָם֙ וְלֹ֤א נִשְׁעַ֙נְתָּ֙ עַל־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ עַל־ כֵּ֗ן נִמְלַ֛ט חֵ֥יל מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָ֖ם מִיָּדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·‘êṯ ha·hî bā ḥă·nā·nî hā·rō·’eh ’el- ’ā·sā me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw bə·hiš·šā·‘en·ḵā ‘al- me·leḵ ’ă·rām wə·lō niš·‘an·tā ‘al- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ‘al- kên nim·laṭ ḥêl me·leḵ- ’ă·rām mî·yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: At that time Hanani the seer came to King Asa of Judah and told him Because you have relied on the king of Aram and not on the LORD your God . . . . . . the army of the king of Aram has escaped from your hand
verses.literalPt: Naquele mesmo tempo veio Hanani, o vidente, a Asa, rei de Judá, e disse-lhe: Porquanto confiaste no rei da Síria, e não confiaste no SENHOR teu Deus, por isso o exército do rei da Síria escapou da tua mão.

verses.original: הֲלֹ֧א הַכּוּשִׁ֣ים וְהַלּוּבִ֗ים הָי֨וּ לְחַ֧יִל׀ לָרֹ֛ב לְרֶ֥כֶב וּלְפָרָשִׁ֖ים לְהַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וּבְהִשָּֽׁעֶנְךָ֥ עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה נְתָנָ֥ם בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō hak·kū·šîm wə·hal·lū·ḇîm hā·yū lə·ḥa·yil lā·rōḇ lə·re·ḵeḇ ū·lə·p̄ā·rā·šîm lə·har·bêh mə·’ōḏ ū·ḇə·hiš·šā·‘en·ḵā ‘al- Yah·weh nə·ṯā·nām bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: Were not the Cushites and Libyans a vast army with many . . . chariots and horsemen Yet because you relied on the LORD He delivered them into your hand
verses.literalPt: Porventura não foram os etíopes e os líbios um grande exército, com muitíssimos carros e cavaleiros? Confiando tu, porém, no SENHOR, ele os entregou nas tuas mãos.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יְהוָ֗ה עֵינָ֞יו מְשֹׁטְט֤וֹת בְּכָל־ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ לְ֠הִתְחַזֵּק עִם־ לְבָבָ֥ם שָׁלֵ֛ם אֵלָ֖יו נִסְכַּ֣לְתָּ עַל־ זֹ֑את כִּ֣י מֵעַ֔תָּה יֵ֥שׁ עִמְּךָ֖ מִלְחָמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh ‘ê·nāw mə·šō·ṭə·ṭō·wṯ bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ lə·hiṯ·ḥaz·zêq ‘im- lə·ḇā·ḇām šā·lêm ’ê·lāw nis·kal·tā ‘al- zōṯ kî mê·‘at·tāh yêš ‘im·mə·ḵā mil·ḥā·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: For the eyes of the LORD roam to and fro over all the earth to show Himself strong on behalf of those whose hearts are fully devoted to Him You have acted foolishly in this matter From now on therefore you will be at . . . war
verses.literalPt: Porque, quanto ao SENHOR, seus olhos passam por toda a terra, para mostrar-se forte para com aqueles cujo coração é perfeito para com ele; nisto, pois, procedeste loucamente porque desde agora haverá guerras contra ti.

verses.original: וַיִּכְעַ֨ס אָסָ֜א אֶל־ הָרֹאֶ֗ה וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֙הוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית הַמַּהְפֶּ֔כֶת כִּֽי־ בְזַ֥עַף עִמּ֖וֹ עַל־ זֹ֑את וַיְרַצֵּ֥ץ אָסָ֛א מִן־ הָעָ֖ם בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḵ·‘as ’ā·sā ’el- hā·rō·’eh way·yit·tə·nê·hū bêṯ ham·mah·pe·ḵeṯ kî- ḇə·za·‘ap̄ ‘im·mōw ‘al- zōṯ way·raṣ·ṣêṣ ’ā·sā min- hā·‘ām bā·‘êṯ ha·hî
verses.literal: Asa was angry with the seer and became so enraged . . . over this matter that he put the man in prison . . . And at the same time Asa oppressed some of the people
verses.literalPt: Porém Asa se indignou contra o vidente, e lançou-o na casa do tronco; porque estava enfurecido contra ele, por causa disto; também Asa, no mesmo tempo, oprimiu a alguns do povo.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י אָסָ֔א הָרִאשׁוֹנִ֖ים וְהָאַחֲרוֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֤ם כְּתוּבִים֙ עַל־ סֵ֣פֶר הַמְּלָכִ֔ים לִיהוּדָ֖ה וְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh diḇ·rê ’ā·sā hā·ri·šō·w·nîm wə·hā·’a·ḥă·rō·w·nîm hin·nām kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er ham·mə·lā·ḵîm lî·hū·ḏāh wə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now the acts of Asa from beginning to end are indeed written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel
verses.literalPt: E eis que os atos de Asa, tanto os primeiros, como os últimos, estão escritos no livro dos reis de Judá e Israel.

verses.original: וַיֶּחֱלֶ֣א אָסָ֡א בִּשְׁנַת֩ שְׁלוֹשִׁ֨ים וָתֵ֤שַׁע לְמַלְכוּתוֹ֙ בְּרַגְלָ֔יו עַד־ לְמַ֖עְלָה חָלְי֑וֹ וְגַם־ בְּחָלְיוֹ֙ לֹא־ דָרַ֣שׁ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֖י בָּרֹפְאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·ḥĕ·le ’ā·sā biš·naṯ šə·lō·wō·šîm wā·ṯê·ša‘ lə·mal·ḵū·ṯōw bə·raḡ·lāw ‘aḏ- lə·ma‘·lāh ḥā·lə·yōw wə·ḡam- bə·ḥā·lə·yōw lō- ḏā·raš ’eṯ- Yah·weh kî bā·rō·p̄ə·’îm
verses.literal: In the thirty-ninth . . . year of his reign Asa became diseased in his feet and his disease became increasingly severe Yet even in his illness he did not seek the LORD but only the physicians
verses.literalPt: E, no ano trinta e nove do seu reinado, Asa caiu doente de seus pés, a sua doença era em extremo grave; contudo, na sua enfermidade, não buscou ao SENHOR, mas antes os médicos.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב אָסָ֖א עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֑יו וַיָּ֕מָת בִּשְׁנַ֛ת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְאַחַ֖ת לְמָלְכֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: So in the forty-first . . . year of his reign Asa died and rested with his fathers
verses.literalPt: E Asa dormiu com seus pais; e morreu no ano quarenta e um do seu reinado.

verses.original: וַיִּקְבְּרֻ֣הוּ בְקִבְרֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּֽרָה־ לוֹ֮ בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִיד֒ וַיַּשְׁכִּיבֻ֗הוּ בַּמִּשְׁכָּב֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִלֵּא֙ בְּשָׂמִ֣ים וּזְנִ֔ים מְרֻקָּחִ֖ים בְּמִרְקַ֣חַת מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ־ ל֥וֹ שְׂרֵפָ֖ה גְּדוֹלָ֥ה עַד־ לִמְאֹֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·bə·ru·hū ḇə·qiḇ·rō·ṯāw ’ă·šer kā·rāh- lōw bə·‘îr dā·wîḏ way·yaš·kî·ḇu·hū bam·miš·kāḇ ’ă·šer mil·lê bə·śā·mîm ū·zə·nîm mə·ruq·qā·ḥîm bə·mir·qa·ḥaṯ ma·‘ă·śeh way·yiś·rə·p̄ū- lōw śə·rê·p̄āh gə·ḏō·w·lāh ‘aḏ- lim·’ōḏ
verses.literal: And he was buried in the tomb that he had cut out for himself in the City of David They laid him on a bier that was full of spices and various blended perfumes . . . then they made a great . . . . . . fire in his honor
verses.literalPt: E o sepultaram no seu sepulcro, que tinha cavado para si na cidade de Davi, havendo-o deitado na cama, que se enchera de perfumes e especiarias preparadas segundo a arte dos perfumistas; e, destas coisas fizeram-lhe uma grande queima.
